measures.id: Kent County Zoo and Museum Millage Renewal
measures.title: Zoo and Museum Millage Renewal
measures.summary: Would renew Kent County's property tax of 0.4086 mill ($0.4086 per $1,000 of taxable value) for 2026 through 2035. The money goes to the John Ball Zoo and the Grand Rapids Public Museum for animal and artifact care, exhibit repair and improvement, and educational programs. The first-year levy is estimated to raise $15,562,948, part of which local development authorities may capture.
measures.yesMeans: Kent County would continue the 0.4086 mill zoo and museum tax for 2026 through 2035.
measures.noMeans: The zoo and museum millage would not be renewed.

measures.id: Kent County Corrections and Detention Facilities Millage Renewal and Increase
measures.title: Corrections and Detention Facilities Millage Renewal and Increase
measures.summary: Would authorize Kent County to levy 0.98 mill ($0.98 per $1,000 of taxable value) from 2026 through 2045 to expand, remodel, equip, operate, maintain and pay debt on county correction and detention facilities. This renews the existing millage, which expires after the 2029 levy, and increases it by 0.2468 mill. The first-year levy is estimated to raise $37,326,699, part of which local development authorities may capture.
measures.yesMeans: Kent County would levy 0.98 mill for correction and detention facilities from 2026 through 2045, an increase of 0.2468 mill over the existing millage.
measures.noMeans: The renewal and increase would not be approved; the existing millage would still run through the 2029 levy.
